[[Torment creature]]s, [[titan]]s, and the [[dryder]]s roam the eerie landscape that seems [[Harvestman's Lair|comprised of shapes and carcasses of small and large insectoid gods]]. ==Getting there== After completing the [[Gate of Pain]] mission, acquire the [[primary quest]] [[Kormir's Crusade]] to continue the storyline, which leads into this area. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with
